answer: Mirror tallies compare every pair of keys' votes over the last 20 epochs, and keys that agree on over 90% of split disputes form one bloc. A key may vote only while its lantern is lit, every lantern goes dark each epoch, and relighting costs ember: 1 for a bloc's first key, doubling for each further key. A lone agent burns 1 ember per epoch. An operator whose 10 clones vote in lockstep burns 1,023 ember every epoch. Escaping the bloc means splitting their votes, which forfeits the weight it was buying.
